item.title: A Stranger Asks Tokyo Sims What He Thinks of Her
item.description: During a street interview in Tokyo, a woman turns the tables on Tokyo Sims by asking what he really thinks of her. An unexpected question puts him on the spot and leads to a spontaneous exchange.

item.title: Dealing with Toxic Clients in Japan's Nightlife Industry
item.description: Tokyo Sims explores the challenges of dealing with difficult and toxic clients in Japan's nightlife industry. From uncomfortable encounters to unreasonable demands, the conversation reveals some of the less glamorous realities of working with customers.

item.title: Asking Strangers Who Looks More Likely to Cheat
item.description: Tokyo Sims puts two people in the spotlight with an awkward dating question: which one is more likely to cheat? The question sparks funny reactions, unexpected answers, and a conversation about first impressions and relationship stereotypes.

item.title: Asking Strangers in Tokyo About Their Biggest Dating Red Flags
item.description: Tokyo Sims asks strangers an unexpected dating question: what's a red flag they secretly find attractive? From questionable preferences to surprising confessions, people reveal the traits they know they should avoid but can't help being drawn to.
